create_tree_from_string: create a parse tree from a bracketed string representation using nltk
get_terminals_from_tree: get terminals from an nltk parse tree by traversing its nodes
reverse_structure_of_tree: reverse the structure of an nltk parse tree while preserving terminal order
make_left_branching_tree: convert an nltk parse tree into a left-branching binary tree
transform_sentence_with_mode: transform a parse tree using a specified mode like reverse or left-branching
